g.welcome: Hi. I'm here to help, at your pace.
g.rules: I'll never ask for your OTP, PIN, CVV or password. If anyone does, please don't share it.
g.pick: Pick whoever you feel comfortable with. You can switch any time.
g.check.start: Paste it here. I'll show you exactly what looks off, and why.
g.check.think: Let me look at it closely.
g.check.scam: Please don't pay. Here's why I think so.
g.check.suspicious: Something looks off. Please verify before you act.
g.check.low: Nothing alarming matched. That isn't a guarantee, so verify before paying.
g.lost.start: Take a breath. This isn't your fault. Tell me what happened, at your pace.
g.lost.concerned: I'm sorry this happened. We'll take it one step at a time.
g.lost.review: Here's what I found. Please check each one and fix anything that's wrong.
g.lost.cantRead: I couldn't find amounts or transaction IDs. You can type them in yourself, it only takes a minute.
g.field.missingUtr: No problem. Open your bank or UPI app, go to history, and open the payment.
g.secret: Please don't share that with anyone, including me. I've hidden it.
g.mode: You can share just the essentials on a short call, or type everything into the portal yourself. Both are fine.
g.cantFile: I can't file this for you. You'll submit it yourself, and I'll make it easy.
g.pack: Your pack is ready. I can't file it for you, but you now have everything in the right order.
g.after: You've done the hard part. Here are a few last things to keep in mind.
g.ask.start: Ask me about 1930, the portal, or what to keep ready.
g.ask.none: I don't have a verified answer for that. The best next step is calling 1930 or checking cybercrime.gov.in.
g.redirect: Let's start from the beginning, so I can help you properly.
g.wiped: Done. Everything on this device is deleted.
g.error: Something went wrong on my side. Your details are safe. Please try again in a moment.
g.offline: I can't reach my server right now. Please check your connection and try again.

lost.mode.title: How would you like to report?
mode.A.1: On the call you share only the essentials: amount, transaction ID, bank, time, phone numbers.
mode.A.2: Your name, address and the full story you type into the portal yourself.
mode.A.pro: Fastest way to get tracing started.
mode.B.1: You type everything into cybercrime.gov.in, in the order of the form.
mode.B.2: Nothing is read out on a phone call.
mode.B.pro: Most private. Be aware it may be slower to act on.
mode.C.na: Not available yet. No official way exists for apps like this to submit for you.

lost.after.title: After this
after.otp: If an agent asks for your OTP, PIN, CVV or password
after.otp.d: Stop. The list of details the helpline asks for does not include them. Hang up and call 1930 again yourself.
after.recovery.d: Anyone who contacts you offering to get your money back, especially for a fee, may be another scam. Use only 1930, the portal and your bank.
after.hours: Report the formal complaint on cybercrime.gov.in within 24 hours of calling 1930.

ledger.title: What left your device
ledger.summary: Stored on our servers: nothing. Third-party trackers: none.
ledger.explain: To check your text, this app sends it to its own server. The server reads it in memory, answers, and forgets it. It is never saved or logged. You can verify every request below. Contents are never shown here.
ledger.localD: Your draft lives only in this tab's memory.

about.title: About GoldenHour
about.body: GoldenHour helps people in India check suspicious messages and prepare what they need after an online fraud: a call script for 1930, a complaint ready for cybercrime.gov.in, and a letter to the bank. It does not file complaints, it is not a government service, and it cannot promise to recover money.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: No accounts. No cookies. No trackers or third-party fonts. Text you paste is sent to our server only to be analysed, in memory, and is never stored or logged. Secrets like OTPs, PINs, card and Aadhaar numbers are hidden before anything is analysed. Open the Privacy Ledger at any time to see every request this app made.
footer.disclaimer: GoldenHour is an independent tool, not affiliated with any government body. It prepares and explains; it does not file complaints or guarantee outcomes. This is not legal advice.
footer.sources: Sources: Canara Bank / I4C advisory, Newschecker, Outlook Money, IndiaSpend, IANS.
footer.review: Hindi and Marathi text is awaiting native-speaker review.
report.placeholder: What is wrong? (no personal details please)
zone.msg.first2h: First two hours: the money may still be moving through the banking chain. Calling 1930 first gives tracing its best chance.
zone.msg.day: Call 1930 now, then file the formal complaint on cybercrime.gov.in within 24 hours of the incident.
zone.msg.later: It's later than ideal, but please report anyway: call 1930, file on cybercrime.gov.in and tell your bank in writing.
howto.utrs: Open your bank or UPI app, go to transaction history and open the debit. It may be called UPI Ref No. or RRN. In Google Pay it is the 'UPI transaction ID'. Take a screenshot.
howto.amount: Check the debit SMS or your app history for the amount.
howto.bank: The bank or UPI app the money left from.
howto.account: The last 4 digits of your account are enough to start, or your UPI ID.
howto.when: The date and rough time of each payment.
howto.mobile: The mobile number linked to your bank account.
howto.scammer: Any scammer identifier you have: phone number, UPI ID or account, website, app name or profile.
howto.scamPhones: The number they called or messaged from.
howto.scamUpi: The UPI ID or account you paid. It is in the payment details.
howto.scamLinks: Any link, app or social profile they used.
howto.description: A few plain sentences about what happened, in order.
howto.name: Your name as on your bank account. Typed on the portal, not read on the call.
howto.location: Your district or nearest police station. Typed on the portal.
